title: Application Load Balancer with AWS Lambda as a target
description: Create an Application Load Balancer with Lambda as target

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how to create an Application Load Balancer with a target AWS Lambda function.

When the load balancer endpoint is hit in the browser, if the specified URL (`/hello`) path matches, it triggers the Lambda function and the file (hello) is downloaded in your local system with the output from Lambda function.
